Hotel Marketing & Representation Guides

AI Search Optimisation for Hotels in India

Make hotel content easier for AI search tools to retrieve by publishing precise property facts in crawlable HTML with consistent names and URLs.

Discuss your project

Publish precise and current answers

Keep address, room attributes, check-in and transport details in readable HTML. Use consistent hotel names and page URLs across the website, maps and relevant trade profiles.

Monitor discovery without relying on a single placement

Check ordinary search visibility, branded search and referral traffic. Use structured data for actual page content and review search snippets for incorrect property facts.
